title: lophiolepis cassia
intro: Lophiolepis cassia, commonly known as Cassia tora, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. Cassia tora is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its multiple health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties, which help to treat various health conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Cassia tora include its ability to act as an immunomodulator, hepatoprotective agent, and antioxidant, which contribute to its use in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Cassia tora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
